_comment: Bandit security baseline for SintraPrime. This file records accepted HIGH-severity findings. New HIGH findings that do not appear here will fail CI. Do not remove entries without a documented security review.

results.issue_text: A Flask app appears to be run with debug=True, which exposes the Werkzeug debugger and allows the execution of arbitrary code.
results._accepted_because: Development-only Flask server entry point guarded by __main__ block. Not invoked in production (gunicorn/uvicorn are used for production deployments).
